measurement: steady_clock; one untimed warmup and five measured repetitions per case
resource_scope: /usr/bin/time -l; whole process including existing suite fixture setup, not memory per journal
limits: Synthetic single-book journal mapping; 100 cash chart accounts, three currencies, unit contributions, 303 result rows.
Full case includes reduction and sorted evidence construction; parsing, ingestion, lifecycle and journal generation excluded.
Prepared-four-partial merge excludes partial computation and is not measured end-to-end parallel speedup.
No Geneva comparison or production service-level acceptance.
